title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(野村一樹研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Nomura Kazuki)
keywords: Food technology (Food engineering) 2.High-pressure technology 3.Food-processing technology 4.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: The foundation of Food technology (Food engineering) is a chemical-engineering process based on the idea that "more effectively". Predecessors have developed a chemical-engineering process for "safer" and "more efficient" processing of foods. The objectives are to understand the basic principles of food technology and to present novel ideas in this field. Also, the purposes are to learn the ideas of improving the quality, branding, expanding distribution, and local contribution by focusing on the local food products, to plan your future activities.
advice: This laboratory focuses on the local food products and studies the following research themes. 1. Improving the quality and branding of the local food products. ・Development and evaluation of the novel processing and storage technologies. 2. Reducing agricultural damage caused by wild birds and animals. ・Development and evaluation of an effective utilization method of the gibier (meat of the wild birds and animals). 3. Clarification of processing mechanism of the traditional products. ・Analysis of various mechanism, such as fermentation, production, and degradation of each component.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledges of biology, chemistry, physics, statistics, and food and nutrition. Basic experimental techniques acquired in "Basic Experiments and Practice in Bioscience and Chemistry" and "Applied Bioscience Major Lab/Exercises" "Advanced Bioengineering" and "Multidisciplinary Practices for Applied Bioscience" are also recommended. Safety first.

activityGoals.body: To able to understand and explained the basic principles of food technology.
To able to understand the qualities of food and changes caused by processing.
To able to understand numerically and discussed logically changes caused by processing and storage.
To able to create presentations and reports based on logical considerations.

achievementLevels.ideal: Research objectives and achievements are presented properly. Research papers on a wide range of themes and create research plans independently. Summarize your research as a PD III report and write it logically.
achievementLevels.standard: Research objectives and achievements are presented properly.

lessons.content: Literature surveys and experimental plans-Students are required to learn the basic operation of experimental equipment and tools. Research and experiment.
Literature surveys and experimental plans-Students are required to start research while formulating short-, medium- and long-term research plans.
Literature surveys and experimental plans-Students are required to make an experimental plan using the PCDA cycle, while conducting research.
Literature surveys and experimental plans-Students are required to summarize the experimental results, while conducting research.
Literature surveys, experimental plans and summary of experimental results. -Making a Project Design III report and prepare for presentation.
lessons.operation: Creating a PD III report and presentation materials, such as presentation script and PowerPoint slides.
lessons.assignments: Conduct over 60 hours of research. Data organization. Prepare for presentation.
